chunks: Of no use was even my wealth.
ai.seo_question: What happens to wealth on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the concept of *fana'* (transience) of worldly wealth, contrasting it with the enduring value of *amal salih* (righteous deeds). It serves as a poignant reminder that material accumulation offers no intercession (*shafa'ah*) or protection against the divine reckoning, emphasizing the spiritual poverty of those who prioritize dunya over akhirah. This regret underscores the ultimate futility of hoarding resources that cannot be transferred to the hereafter.
